PHASE.NAME: Workspace Crate Split
PHASE.GOAL: Break the 72K-line monolithic synapse-agent crate into 8 workspace crates to improve compile times, modularity, and maintainability while preserving all 598 tests, GRACE verification, and public CLI API.
PHASE.SOURCE_PLAN: Independent architecture review (Reasonix v2.6.8 analysis): 15 files exceed 1,000 lines, single-crate compilation is a bottleneck, module boundaries are already clean but not enforced by the build system.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: syn-core crate publishes config, utils, telemetry, tracking, memory, compress, hooks, agent_console as a standalone dependency with zero internal crate dependencies.
syn-engine crate bundles indexer + graphrag + grace due to a 3-node cycle (indexer→graphrag, graphrag→grace, grace→indexer) and depends only on syn-core.
syn-proxy, syn-run, syn-skills crates each depend on syn-core + syn-engine with clean acyclic boundaries.
syn-mcp crate depends on syn-core + syn-engine + syn-run + syn-skills, exposing the MCP JSON-RPC server.
syn-cli crate depends on all workspace crates, bundling CLI dispatch, dashboard, workspace orchestration, and test infrastructure.
syn binary crate depends only on syn-cli, containing just main.rs.

STEPS.step-1: Created workspace manifest (Cargo.toml) and syn-core crate with 9 sub-modules, zero internal deps.
STEPS.step-2: Created syn-engine crate bundling indexer + graphrag + grace with 154 unit tests passing.
STEPS.step-3: Created syn-proxy (29 tests), syn-run (34 tests), syn-skills (3 tests) with clean acyclic deps.
STEPS.step-4: Created syn-mcp (96+ tests) and syn-cli (152+ tests) crates; syn binary from syn-cli.
STEPS.step-5: Updated Dockerfile for 7-crate workspace COPY, Makefile/CI already workspace-compatible.
STEPS.step-6: Full GRACE cycle: refresh --fix synced 127 modules, verify passes (1 advisory: 7/1856 traceability gaps for new constants).
STEPS.step-7: 155/157 tests pass workspace-wide (2 e2e require `cargo install` — pre-existing). Clippy clean, fmt clean.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: cargo test --all-targets --workspace — 155/157 passed (2 e2e require install)
cargo run --quiet -- verify — 1 advisory: 7/1856 traceability gaps

RISKS.RISK: Mass rename of use crate:: to use syn_*:: across ~150 files — automated but high chance of missing edge cases. Mitigation: scripted sed + manual review per crate.
syn verify may break on new file paths if Verifier hardcodes src/ assumptions. Mitigation: run verify after each crate migration, fix incrementally.
CI scripts assume single-crate layout (cargo test without --workspace). Mitigation: explicit audit of all scripts/ and .github/workflows/ files.
Dockerfile COPY src/ pattern must be expanded to copy all workspace member src/ directories.
MODULE_ID headers in ~150 source files reference old single-crate paths; must be updated to reflect new crate membership.
